query: TSMC AI accelerator revenue growth latest quarter
normalized: accelerator ai growth quarter revenue tsmc

output.content:
TSMC does **not disclose a stand-alone quarterly AI-accelerator revenue figure or quarterly growth rate**; the closest reported platform measure is High-Performance Computing (HPC), which includes AI accelerators. [[1]] 

In the latest reported quarter, **Q3 2026**, HPC revenue grew **22% quarter over quarter** and represented **68% of TSMC’s total revenue**. [[1]] 

For its narrower AI-accelerator category, management’s prior outlook was a **mid- to high-50% CAGR for 2024–2029**; at the Q3 call, CEO C.C. Wei said demand was “extremely robust,” with no slowdown evident, and that growth would “probably” be higher than that prior range. [[1, 2]] 

For context, TSMC’s overall Q3 2026 revenue was **US$46.72 billion**, up **16.2% sequentially** in U.S.-dollar terms. [[3, 1]]

sources.title: TSMC 2026 Q3 Quarterly Results - Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited
